_comment: Figures are public manufacturer/press specifications, not certified engineering data. Each model carries a `source` field. Real-world range varies widely with load, route, driver and weather.

reference_conditions.note: base_consumption is the measured/derived figure at this model's reference_gcw_tonnes, on flat terrain at 15 C.

models.name: Volvo FH Electric
models.source: Volvo Trucks: up to 540 kWh onboard / 460 kWh usable, 'up to 300 km'. Consumption 1.1 kWh/km measured on the Green Truck Route test (345 km achieved at 80 km/h average).

models.name: Volvo FH Aero Electric
models.source: Volvo Trucks: 540 kWh onboard / 460 kWh UBE, 'up to 600 km'. base_consumption derived as 460/600; an optimistic manufacturer figure measured under favourable conditions.

models.name: Volvo FH Aero Electric Long Range
models.source: Volvo Trucks: 6-8 L-shaped packs, 780 kWh installed / 725 kWh UBE, 'up to 700 km', 20-80% in ~40 min via MCS. Orders expected Q2 2026. base_consumption derived as 725/700.

models.name: Volvo FM Electric
models.source: Volvo Trucks: shares the FH Electric platform, up to 540 kWh onboard / 460 kWh usable. Consumption estimated slightly above FH Electric (less aerodynamic cab).

models.name: Volvo FE Electric
models.source: Volvo Trucks / electrive: 280-375 kWh (3-4 packs), range up to 275 km; up to 200 km with electro-mechanical PTO. Twin-motor, up to 225 kW. Usable capacity estimated at ~88% of gross.

models.name: Volvo FL Electric
models.source: Volvo Trucks / electrive: 3-6 packs, 280-565 kWh, 280 km (3 packs) to 450 km (6 packs) in distribution traffic. Single-motor, up to 180 kW. Figures here are the 6-pack maximum configuration.

models.name: Volvo FL Electric 14-tonne
models.source: Volvo Trucks (announced Dec 2025): LFP packs, 176 kWh gross / 145 kWh usable, up to 200 km, 180 kW motor. Charges 43 kW AC or 150 kW DC. base_consumption derived as 145/200.

models.name: Volvo FH (diesel)
models.source: Tank: Volvo lists max fuel volume 1510 L for a 4x2 tractor; a typical max-capacity build is 900 L + 570 L. 1000 L used as a common real-world configuration. Consumption: FH460 averaged 28.93 L/100km over a 30-month seven-truck comparison test.

models.name: Volvo FH Aero (diesel)
models.source: Shares FH tank architecture. Consumption: FH Aero recorded 25.1 L/100km (11.25 mpg) on Commercial Motor's standardised test route in Nov 2025 - a record run; 26.5 used here as a slightly more representative mixed-running figure.

models.name: Volvo FM (diesel)
models.source: Volvo lists FM AdBlue 32-112 L with tank architecture shared with FH. Fuel tank and consumption figures are estimated from the FH baseline with a penalty for the less aerodynamic cab.

models.name: Volvo FMX (diesel)
models.source: Estimated. Construction-spec chassis carry smaller tanks (the Indian FMX is listed at 290 L total) and consume more due to off-road duty cycles and heavier bodywork.

models.name: Volvo FE (diesel)
models.source: Volvo lists FE fuel volume 160-630 L (plastic/steel/aluminium, two D-tank heights) and a 32 L AdBlue tank. Consumption estimated for 27 t urban distribution duty.

models.name: Volvo FL (diesel)
models.source: Estimated. Volvo did not publish FL tank figures in the sources consulted; the FL is lighter than the FE, so tank and consumption are scaled below the FE's 160-630 L band.
